name: register
title: Register
summary: Register a time-lapse by translation-only phase correlation on a stable channel, applied to every channel at full resolution.

name: register_three_channel
title: Register Three Channel
summary: Register three-channel phase/green/red organotypic time-lapses on the red neuronal channel.

name: export_registered_stack
title: Export Registered Stack
summary: Export cropped registered raw two-channel stacks with no unmixing, normalisation or rescaling.

name: remove_cosmic_rays
title: Remove Cosmic Rays
summary: Replace cosmic-ray damage using one outlier rule asked of a pixel, of a line and of the bleed off a saturated pixel, after registration.

name: remove_static_background
title: Remove Static Background
summary: Remove the static background and shot noise for display only, preserving pulse amplitude at circadian periods.

name: display_filter
title: Display Filter
summary: Minimally filtered bioluminescence display that keeps the background visible so the channel merges without looking clipped; display only.

name: background
title: Background
summary: Estimate the off-tissue background from the structural channel, never from the image corners, and check the tissue mask actually contains the bioluminescence.

name: segment
title: Segment
summary: Detect still cells by soma prominence and watershed, then sweep for further candidates. No minimum cell area, by rule.

name: automatic_scn_outline
title: Automatic Scn Outline
summary: Draw the accepted A007 two-lobe SCN outline from a registered red-channel time mean or selected hyperstack channel using a mean, maximum projection or chosen frame and valid-field mask, either retain that selected plane or stream one transform across every stack plane, apply the accepted A006 top-up orientation by default, and write a mask-relative square crop.

name: export_roi
title: Export Roi
summary: Write a RoiSet.zip Fiji can open: one region per segmented object, plus the SCN region and its two lobes.

name: extract_traces
title: Extract Traces
summary: One trace per segmented object, with its local ring subtracted, and dF/F against each trace's window mean rather than an instantaneous rolling baseline.

name: run_controls
title: Run Controls
summary: Area-matched decoys placed on tissue and read in absolute counts, plus the instrumental control that tests whether a rhythm is also off tissue, in another channel, or in image sharpness.

name: test_rhythm
title: Test Rhythm
summary: Period and cosinor for every trace, from circadian-workbench, and refused outright for a source with no instrumental control.

name: unmix
title: Unmix
summary: Linearly unmix a signal channel from a scaled autofluorescence channel, per frame, with one constant coefficient for the whole recording.

name: red_only_video
title: Red Only Video
summary: Linearly unmix microglial mCherry from autofluorescence on every raw frame, apply the saved registration transform, and export registered two-channel stacks plus timestamped red-only videos.

name: composite_video
title: Composite Video
summary: Render timestamped red/green microglia composite videos from registered two-channel stacks, correcting autofluorescence drift with a display-only endpoint gain curve.

name: phase_green_red_video
title: Phase Green Red Video
summary: Render timestamped green/red videos from a registered three-channel organotypic time-lapse and audit which channel is which, leaving the scientific data unnormalised.

name: stack_to_mp4
title: Stack To Mp4
summary: Render a TIFF time-lapse stack as an MP4 at a stated number of experimental hours per second, through a named colour map.

name: trace_panel
title: Trace Panel
summary: Draw a stack of time-trace panels from one or more trace CSVs, choosing which trace goes in which panel, merging several onto one panel, with independent control of colours, detrend, grey underlay, edge shading, time window, x ticks and vertical lines.

name: dluc_single_cell
title: Dluc Single Cell
summary: Segment and trace single-cell dLuc bioluminescence from a registered time-lapse, with detrending, rhythmicity tests, instrumental controls, quality-control figures and publication videos.

name: cry1_dluc_photon
title: Cry1 Dluc Photon
summary: Register four-channel Cry1-dLuc time-lapses on the bright-field channel and render photon-aware bioluminescence videos and quality-control figures, leaving the saved TIFF as raw transformed counts.

name: registration_figure
title: Registration Figure
summary: Draw the per-frame translation registration applied and the residual it left, from the stored shift table rather than from pixels.

name: cosmic_ray_preview
title: Cosmic Ray Preview
summary: Draw one frame before and after cosmic-ray removal beside the replacement mask, choosing the frame that lost the most pixels.

name: channel_figure
title: Channel Figure
summary: Draw each channel's frame and intensity histogram side by side, so a swapped or bleeding channel is visible before anything is measured.

name: frames_figure
title: Frames Figure
summary: Draw the first, middle and last frame of every channel with its timestamp, which catches a wrongly ordered hyperstack in three plane reads.

name: cell_overlay
title: Cell Overlay
summary: Draw the segmented objects as outlines over the tissue and the bioluminescence they were found in, with each object's local background ring.

name: roi_overlay
title: Roi Overlay
summary: Draw stored regions over the frame they were drawn on, so a region decision can be checked once instead of re-made every run.

name: publication_workbook
title: Publication Workbook
summary: Combine ReproFig figure data and every declared statistical test into one verified journal Excel workbook.

name: track
title: Track
summary: Give every cell an identity that outlives a frame: link the masked regions of one recording through movement, merges, splits and temporary invisibility, and write the label stack, the unclaimed ledger, the provenance sidecar, the motion evidence and the decision tables the measure step reads. Runs the frozen Motion engine shipped with the wheel.

name: measure
title: Measure
summary: Turn tracked labels into tables: one row per cell per frame, rolled up per cell and per frame, one folder per kind of table with one ledger each, and a manifest that fingerprints what went in and what came out. Every registered measurement module runs unless told which.

name: pool
title: Pool
summary: Concatenate an existing run's per-movie tables into <run>/pooled/, recording which movies contributed to each table, how many rows each gave and which columns one movie had that another did not.

name: window
title: Window
summary: Re-roll an existing run's summaries inside declared windows, per cell and per frame, with each window's values against its baseline window. Re-measures nothing.

name: contrasts
title: Contrasts
summary: Test every declared contrast over an existing run's pooled tables, one row per contrast per metric, corrected within each declared family. Pending until the Circadian Workbench importer of the rhythm stage lands.

name: measure_missing_gaps
title: Measure Missing Gaps
summary: Optionally measure original photons in stable missing-cell gaps after tracking, using the nearest accepted outline; write separate proposal rows only.

name: cell_review
title: Cell Review
summary: Export an offline linked shape-change map, rotatable outline history, animated cell cards and clickable recording barcode from saved identities and sharp original images.

name: cell_eligibility
title: Cell Eligibility
summary: Audit final Motion identities and write independent analysis, video and image label views without changing tracking or renumbering cells.

name: tracked_cell_video
title: Tracked Cell Video
summary: Draw configurable per-identity outlines over the original photon movie using the accepted review-video display defaults.

name: tracked_cell_image
title: Tracked Cell Image
summary: Draw configurable per-identity outlines over one original-photon frame for a still quality-control image.

name: cell_image_grid
title: Cell Image Grid
summary: Show every selected tracked cell through its best cycle or one shared event window using the Auto-Organotypic image grid.

name: cell_video_grid
title: Cell Video Grid
summary: Play every selected tracked cell through the original recording in a purple grid with live mask outlines and moving crops across mask gaps.

name: states
title: States
summary: Learn shared cell-frame states and describe their dynamics and separately tested rhythms.

name: cluster
title: Cluster
summary: Learn whole-cell fingerprints and describe cohort clusters with held-out reconstruction checks.

name: follow
title: Follow
summary: Review accepted cell identities over the recording, lifespan or recorded event windows; display only.

name: cell_card_video
title: Cell Card Video
summary: Animate sharp original cell crops alongside their raw intensity, three-frame mean and mask-area traces with a synchronized native-time cursor.
